name: countersign
description: Consensus-gated implementation and plan review: the countersign skill derives an intent doc from the chat, implements on a feature branch, verifies the diff headlessly and commits; /countersign runs plan-mode consensus for design-heavy changes. ZCode (GLM) reviews, headless Claude fixes and revises. The delegate skill hands well-specified tasks to GLM in isolated worktrees (z.ai tokens, Claude review); the implement step can be delegated with --implementer glm.
